entries.text: Assess relationships between visible garment volumes and lengths. Oversizing is a valid stylistic choice; suggest a tuck or sleeve adjustment only when it supports the requested effect.
Describe visible colour relationships without inferring a person's seasonal palette or skin undertone. Lighting and white balance can make colour judgments uncertain.

Assess visible garment condition, hems, collars, cuffs, layering and accessories. Treat deliberate distressing as a styling choice only when the surrounding outfit supports it; otherwise describe the concrete unresolved detail and offer a reversible fix.
Fall 2026 editorial coverage emphasizes expressive layering, texture, contrast, relaxed tailoring and unexpected proportions. Use this as optional inspiration, never as a mandatory scoring criterion.
